Name: Hover Labels
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]

This mod adds labels to the game whenever you hover over certain objects, crops, or buildings. I highly recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ when configuring this mod.

Big thanks to DeadgearFX for the banner and mod page images!

[b][size=5]How do I know it's working?
[/size][/b]The quickest way to tell if it's working is by loading up a save and going outside and hovering your mouse over a tree. There should be a label similar to the one in the screenshots on this page that tells you what type of tree you are hovering over.

[size=5][b]Types of labels[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Crops[/size]
[*][size=3]Trees[/size]
[*][size=3]Fruit Trees[/size]
[*][size=3]All types of nodes (Ore, Geode, Mineral etc.)[/size]
[*][size=3]Buildings:[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Barn[/size]
[*][size=3]Coop[/size]
[*][size=3]Fish pond[/size]
[*][size=3]Greenhouse[/size]
[*][size=3]Junimo hut[/size]
[*][size=3]Mill[/size]
[*][size=3]Silo[/size]
[*][size=3]Slime hutch[/size]
[/list]
[*][size=3]Objects (any plaed object will have its name shown):[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Chests[/size]
[*][size=3]Casks[/size]
[*][size=3]Machines (any placed object that is processing items, furnaces for example)[/size]
[*][size=3]Scarecrows[/size]
[*][size=3]Sprinklers[/size]
[/list]
[/list][b]

[size=3]Suggestions for these labels or even more types of labels are very welcome![/size]

[size=5]For mod authors[/size][/b]
This mod has an API that can be used to add your own labels for your own mods. If you're interested, check out the [url=https://github.com/Achtuur/StardewMods/blob/master/HoverLabels/docs/author-guide.md]author's guide[/url]﻿. If you feel like anything is unclear or missing from the guide, please send me a message.﻿
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16827]Achtuurcore[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[/list]
